title: What Can I Control?
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Sort common waiting-period worries into what you can act on and what's out of your hands, and turn each controllable worry into a small next step.

learningObjectives: Students will classify common waiting-period worries as within or outside their control and plan one concrete action for each controllable worry.

controls: I can do something about this button

keyQuestions: Why does checking the portal ten times a day make waiting harder?
Which of your worries has a next step you could take this week?
Who can you talk to when the waiting feels heavy?
commonMisconceptions: Worrying harder can change a decision.
Nothing can be done while you wait.
assessmentOpportunities: Students sort the deck and produce a plan with at least three concrete, scheduled next steps.
